NAME: Transitive-Symmetric Relation-Idempotent of a Non-Transitive-Symmetric Relation
GENESIS: Invert the 'transitive' closure operator on the 'symmetric' closure operator, then collapse the resulting 3-ary tensor into a self-referential 2-ary projector via literalized arrow-reversal.
FORMAL_SEED: (R ⇒ (R ⇒ R)) ⇒ R ⇒ R
STRANGE_PROPERTY: The projection is idempotent but does not satisfy the natural projection property; it is a 'subspace'-like projection that is not a subspace.
NEAREST_KNOWN_RELATIVE: Projection Operator
WHY_NOT_JUST_RENAMING: The transitive and symmetric operators are not independent, but inverting them creates a new operator.
COUNTERFEIT: Idempotent Operator
BREAK_IT: Fails on a 3-cycle (1 ⇒ 2, 2 ⇒ 3, 3 ⇒ 1)
NEXT_MUTATION: Take the dual of the operator.
